verdicts.reason: A keeps the original centered stack (logo, headline, CTA) with clear hierarchy and even spacing, but it is basically a crop of the square. It doesn't use the wide shape: there's a lot of empty space on both sides, and the CTA sits fairly close to the bottom edge. B blows the headline up so it wraps awkwardly ('Chase the / Light') and nearly touches the top edge. Its CTA is enlarged until it competes with the headline, and it's jammed close to the bottom edge. The logo is pushed small to the far left, which makes the layout lopsided and cramped.
